title: 18_6369445_General_1948_Vol_1
doc_notes: This document is a collection of correspondence, routing sheets, and memorandums from the Department of the Air Force in 1948 regarding the reporting and investigation of 'Flying Discs' and the establishment of Project SIGN.

incidents.summary: Four witnesses observed a round, phosphorescent object moving at high speed with a phosphorescent trail at an altitude of 6-8 miles.
incidents.quote: round, appeared to be nine inches in diameter from ground level

incidents.summary: Observation of two objects falling to earth described as similar to falling aircraft with smoke and debris trailing.
incidents.quote: two objects falling to earth from unknown source

incidents.summary: Observation of two objects falling to earth, one appearing to be on fire with red and black smoke trailing.
incidents.quote: One object seemed to be on fire with red and black smoke trailing behind
